scope.summary: Cross-module document handoff.** Another module MAY carry a Studio document as an attachment or an embedded view. Two behaviours are required, and both are ONE navigation-target variant on the EXISTING navigation layers, never new routing machinery ([STU-SHL-006]): 1. **Embedded edit in place.** The embedding module renders a Studio viewport inline over the same document authority. The embedded viewport MUST render correctly with all four edge docks absent ([STU-SHL-069] item 4) and MUST expose the same `author_id` addresses as the full viewport, suffixed per [STU-MDL-103] when a second instance exists. 2. **Open in Studio.** Opening the attachment swaps the viewport to Studio ([STU-SHL-098] path 1), shows the SAVED STATE of documents already open, and opens the attachment as a NEW TAB rather than replacing an existing one. If the attachment is already open, its existing tab is focused and no second tab is created. --- ### 6. Pointer gesture arbitration

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
